card.name: Tenofovir and antiviral drug names
card.fires_on: The start of 'tenofovir' (the 'ten' piece) after emtricitabine, and small linking words like 'to', 'and', 'without' right before an antiviral drug name in HIV or flu labels.

modes.label: Start of tenofovir
modes.description: The 'ten' or 'T' piece beginning tenofovir or TDF after another HIV drug name.

modes.label: Link word before antiviral name
modes.description: 'to', 'and' or 'without' just before a named antiviral drug, such as after hypersensitivity.
